findings.message: 16 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Membres" (pill) above "Les entreprises qui composent l'alliance"; "Bangangté" above "Clemios"; "Bangangté" above "Skyeng Pro"; "Bangangté" above "Mboa Intech"; "Bangangté" above "Yaba-In"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 2 gradient fill(s): span.about__video-overlay → linear-gradient(rgba(15, 35, 48, 0.08), rgba(15, 35, 48, 0.72)) | footer#footer.footer.ng-trigger → radial-gradient(at 50% 100%, rgba(0, 139, 207, 0.12), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 672px), linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(3,
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 42 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.login-link → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18) 0px 6px 18px 0px | div.hero__panel → rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.2) 0px 18px 40px 0px | a.btn.btn-primary → rgba(0, 68, 126, 0.18) 0px 10px 24px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).
Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The margins differ: 141px on the left, 111px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (it is at 28% opacity).
findings.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Uniting Cameroonian Forces in New Technologies!" → 3 lines (6 words, 35.2px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.
